 Explore Beautiful Door County on Kayak
Create your own kayak adventure in Door County with a rental. Does the idea of less structure and more freedom sound enticing? Then you should check out our kayak rental options! We rent tandem sit-on-top kayaks that can be paddled by one or two people. Our kayaks are easy for everyone! Get out on the water and explore the beauty of Door County.
